 Your Philadelphia Union enter this weekend's clash with the Revolution with another opportunity to secure a berth into the postseason.
 Philadelphia will clinch a berth in the Audi 2026 MLS Cup Playoffs if one of the following scenarios occur:
 Philadelphia Union win vs. New England Revolution OR 
 Philadelphia Union draw vs. New England Revolution AND Red Bull New York draw vs. Inter Miami CF OR 
 ❌Columbus Crew draw vs. Toronto FC OR 
 Red Bull New York lose vs. Inter Miami CF
